question: 0.025 µm के रुक्षता मान के लिए रुक्षता ग्रेड संख्या की पहचान कीजिए।
solution:
**Concept**

 
• Surface roughness refers to the irregularities in the surface texture. It is often quantified by the arithmetic mean deviation, denoted as R_a.
 
• According to international standards (ISO), surface roughness values are categorized into roughness grade numbers ranging from N1 to N12.
 
• Each grade number corresponds to a specific maximum R_a value in micrometers (mu m).
